request: A robot controller heat bridge carries 5 W to an ideal 20 C cold end; keep the bridge at or below 40 C.

scenarios.use: 高校机械专业学生，设计移动机器人控制板导热支座
scenarios.success: At 5 W and the same ideal 20 C cold end, maximum bridge temperature <=40 C.

checks.question: Does the bridge fit its declared mounts without interfering with the cover?
checks.user_impact: Avoid an efficient thermal revision that cannot be assembled.
checks.reason: Avoid an efficient thermal revision that cannot be assembled.
checks.acceptance: Check 40 mm length, 20 mm width, thickness <=4 mm, assembly constraints and cover clearance against CAD.
assumptions: 常导热系数167 W/(m K)的铝等效筛查假设；物性范围0–120°C

checks.question: Does a steady thermal-resistance estimate identify an inadequate conducting section?
checks.user_impact: A cheap estimate can test the direction of a CAD change before solid meshing.
checks.reason: A cheap estimate can test the direction of a CAD change before solid meshing.
checks.acceptance: At 5 W, k=167 W/(m K), cold end 20 C, hot-node temperature <=40 C.
assumptions: 常导热系数167 W/(m K)的铝等效筛查假设；物性范围0–120°C
checks.load_path: Heater -> bridge conducting section -> ideal cold reservoir.
checks.load_basis: Declared total 5 W input, unchanged between revisions.
checks.support_basis: Cold end fixed at 20 C; other faces insulated. Real interfaces remain unverified.

checks.question: How does the assumed lumped heater warm up under the stated heat capacity?
checks.user_impact: Time to approach a limit depends on heat capacity; steady temperature alone does not give it.
checks.reason: Time to approach a limit depends on heat capacity; steady temperature alone does not give it.
checks.acceptance: Compare the computed temperature history with the case's unchanged 40 C limit over its stated time window.
assumptions: 常导热系数167 W/(m K)的铝等效筛查假设；物性范围0–120°C
checks.load_path: Heater -> bridge conducting section -> ideal cold reservoir.
checks.load_basis: Declared total 5 W input, unchanged between revisions.
checks.support_basis: Cold end fixed at 20 C; other faces insulated. Real interfaces remain unverified.

checks.question: Does the selected bridge satisfy the spatial temperature requirement?
checks.user_impact: Locate the hot region and verify whether changing only the conducting section addresses it.
targets: Bridge solid and its hot/cold end faces
checks.reason: Locate the hot region and verify whether changing only the conducting section addresses it.
checks.acceptance: Maximum temperature <=40 C with the original temperature-convergence and energy-balance gates.
assumptions: 常导热系数167 W/(m K)的铝等效筛查假设；物性范围0–120°C
checks.load_path: Heater -> bridge conducting section -> ideal cold reservoir.
checks.load_basis: Declared total 5 W input, unchanged between revisions.
checks.support_basis: Cold end fixed at 20 C; other faces insulated. Real interfaces remain unverified.

checks.question: Can the real mounting maintain the modeled cold end and heat path?
checks.user_impact: An ideal prescribed sink can make an inadequate real cooling system look sufficient.
targets: Heat-source interface, cold-end interface and real cooling
checks.reason: An ideal prescribed sink can make an inadequate real cooling system look sufficient.
checks.acceptance: Measure cold-end temperature and interface resistance under the declared 5 W duty before claiming real-product thermal performance.
assumptions: 常导热系数167 W/(m K)的铝等效筛查假设；物性范围0–120°C
